alternatives.name: Semrush
alternatives.whyChoose: Includes content optimization plus keyword research, rank tracking, and broader SEO tools. Better value for full SEO needs.

alternatives.name: Ahrefs
alternatives.whyChoose: Content Explorer for content research plus backlink analysis. Better for content strategy with link-building.

alternatives.name: Grammarly
alternatives.whyChoose: Writing assistant focused on grammar and style. Better for basic writing quality without SEO optimization.

faqs.q: How much does Surfer SEO cost?
faqs.a: Surfer SEO pricing starts at $49 per month for Discovery ($39 billed annually), $99 for Standard ($79 annually), $182 for Pro ($145 annually), and $299 for Peace of Mind ($239 annually). Enterprise starts at $999 per month.

faqs.q: Does Surfer SEO have a free trial?
faqs.a: No free trial. Surfer offers a 7-day money-back guarantee. The Discovery plan at $49/month is the entry point.
Surfer SEO analyzes top-ranking pages and provides data-driven recommendations for content optimization, including word count, keyword usage, headings, and structure.

faqs.q: Is Surfer SEO worth it for a solo blogger?
faqs.a: If you publish 10+ articles per month, the Standard plan at $99/month provides value. For fewer articles, the Discovery plan at $49/month may be sufficient.

faqs.q: Does Surfer SEO integrate with WordPress?
faqs.a: Yes, Surfer integrates with WordPress and Google Docs for real-time content optimization without switching between tools.

faqs.q: Can Surfer SEO replace keyword research tools?
faqs.a: No. Surfer focuses on content optimization, not keyword research. You still need tools like Ahrefs or Semrush for keyword research and rank tracking.
